meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 交付代码前先自己跑一遍人工验收,再让一名审查者逐项把关目标、约束、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次提 PR 前都担心漏掉验收步骤或质量问题
copy.tagline_en: Run your own manual QA, then one focused gate review before the PR handoff
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a consistent quality gate before every PR handoff.

howto.what: 它会先自己在真实界面上做手工 QA 并留下证据，再只启动一个门禁审查代理（不是一组）核查目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文和 QA 证据；QA 无失败行且审查代理返回 APPROVE 才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接前，或你明确要求复审已完成的实现工作时触发。

say.text: PR 交接前帮我门禁复审一下这次改动
say.note: 先手工 QA，再派一个审查代理

say.text: 用 review-work 复查这个分支，把 QA 矩阵和结论给我
say.note: 产出 QA 矩阵行和审查结论

say.text: 修复完之后再对这个增量门禁复审一遍
say.note: 复审查按增量重新启动

howto.what_en: Claude runs hands-on manual QA on the real surface, then launches exactly ONE gate reviewer (not a panel) to audit goal, constraints, quality, security and QA evidence. It passes only when no QA row fails and the reviewer approves.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Gate-review this change before the PR handoff
say_en.note: Runs manual QA first, then one gate reviewer.

say_en.text: Re-run review-work on this branch and give me the QA matrix and verdict
say_en.note: QA rows plus the reviewer's decision.

say_en.text: After the fix, gate-review the delta again
say_en.note: Re-review starts as a fresh spawn on the delta.
